name: Room of Hidden Secrets
summary: The Room of Hidden Secrets is a quiet interior chamber tucked within the Scarlet Monastery's armory wing, situated between the Hall of Champions and the Gallery of Treasures. Despite its enigmatic and solemn name, any profound lore or hidden arcane mysteries within its walls remain an elusive curiosity to the zealots stationed nearby.

sections.title: An Unassuming Sanctuary
sections.body: Located in the fortified passages leading toward the armory's innermost treasury, the Room of Hidden Secrets appears to be little more than another stone-walled chamber built during the monastery's expansion. Positioned directly beyond the Hall of Champions and just before the Gallery of Treasures, it sits within the heavily guarded bastion of the Scarlet Crusade. While its grand title implies concealed relics or classified Crusade doctrines, the Crusaders themselves pay little attention to whatever mundane or supernatural oddities linger unseen in the corners.

sections.title: Unseen Inhabitants
sections.body: Those gifted with supernatural perception or specialized sensory aids claim the room harbors an entirely different kind of mystery. Wandering unseen across the cold flagstones are phantasmal rodents, known to observers as Sekret and Sekrit. These ghostly critters are completely invisible to ordinary mortal eyes, slipping silently beneath the notice of the fanatical guards marching through the halls.

faq.q: Where is the Room of Hidden Secrets located?
aliases: where is room of hidden secrets
faq.answer: It is located inside the Armory wing of the Scarlet Monastery. You pass through it after clearing the Hall of Champions and immediately before stepping into the Gallery of Treasures.

faq.q: What is actually hidden in this room?
aliases: what secrets are in the room
faq.answer: Rather than forbidden Crusade records or holy relics, the only hidden presences detected within the room are a pair of ethereal phantom rodents named Sekret and Sekrit, which remain invisible to the naked eye.

faq.q: How can you see the spirits in this chamber?
faq.answer: The spectral rodents cannot be viewed by normal vision. They can only be revealed through the keen senses granted by specialized detection abilities used by rogues or through the technological optics of an Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer.

faq.q: Does the Scarlet Crusade know about the room's secret?
faq.answer: There is no indication the Crusade is aware of the ghostly rodents. The zealots are entirely preoccupied with their paranoid holy war against the undead, leaving the minor spectral quirks of their monastery unnoticed.

angles.text: Rogues with sharp senses can utilize their Detection abilities to spot the otherwise invisible phantom rats roaming the stone floors.
Engineers equipped with an Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer can pierce the veil to glimpse the ethereal creatures hiding in plain sight.
